newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU OPENS NEW BRANCH IN DAUGAVPILS.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU OPENS NEW BRANCH IN DAUGAVPILS.

text.p: Latvia's Rietumu Bank said on Monday that it has opened its new branch in Latvia's second largest town, Daugavpils, in the east of the country.
The bank said in a statement that one of the key aims of the new branch will be corporate banking.

"We already have clients in Daugavpils and they are big clients. We are not coming to an empty place," Rietumu Bank president Arkardi Suharenko was quoted as saying at the opening of the branch on Friday.

"Daugavpils is one of the largest towns in the country, it is a big region with its own qualities, industrial and trade centre, its own role in the economy of the state and an independent nature," he was quoted as adding.
